propositions: Replace the grandfathered module-size allowlist escape hatch with an absolute 800 LOC cap stored in a single-source limit file read by both CI workflows.
Implement a limit-lock mechanism that fetches main's tip by explicit GitHub URL and fails if the base limit differs from the current limit, preventing changes to the cap without admin override.

Rewrite the module-size gate in both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml workflows to read the limit file, enforce the absolute cap with no exemptions, and emit a warning (not silent failure) if the main fetch fails.
Update the module-size contract test to read the cap from the limit file, drop allowlist/ceilings sync assertions, and verify no src/rebar file exceeds the cap.
Retain the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files during Phase 2a so the current gate remains green on main; Phase 2b will delete them after the new gate is live.
Guard against missing limit file by explicitly failing the gate if the file is absent.
